city_status.summary_en: Air quality in Belgrade is moderate; sensitive individuals may experience slight effects.

superintelligence_monologue.speaker: Sumnjalo
superintelligence_monologue.text_sr: Odbacujem Connectorovu tvrdnju da je Observerovo poređenje parkinga prevaziđeno: aktuelne činjenice i dalje pokazuju promenu na Masarikovoj sa 272 na 115, bez vremena merenja. Ne mogu da pretvorim starost prijema od 86 min za SEPA i 56 min za Parking Servis u istovremene uslove na ulici. Ni naslov o struji i vodi ne smatram potvrdom prekida na bilo kojoj određenoj lokaciji; njegov geografski obuhvat ostaje nepotvrđen. [F6][F2][F5][F11]
superintelligence_monologue.text_en: I reject Connector’s claim that Observer’s parking comparison was overtaken: the current facts still show Masarikova moving from 272 to 115, without measurement times [F6]. I cannot turn reception ages of 86 min for SEPA and 56 min for Parking Servis into simultaneous street conditions [F2][F5]. Nor do I treat the electricity-and-water headline as confirmation of an outage at any particular location; its geographic scope remains unconfirmed [F11].
